name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (render domain). Descriptor accurately captures behaviour: draws a proportional HP bar for one combatant by scaling current/max HP to a filled-segment count. No Ghidra address residue; no embedded domain ID to preserve.
purpose: Draw a proportional HP bar inside a combatant panel: scale a combatant's current HP to a 0x45-wide bar and forward the filled-segment count to the shared segmented-bar renderer.
logic_summary: pchar = runtime_char_array[char_idx]. If pchar->hp_current == 0 (dead) return without drawing. Otherwise hp_scaled = (int32)hp_current * 0x45 (0x45=69=max bar width); segments = hp_scaled / (int32)hp_max + 1 (the +1 keeps a >=1 head while alive). bar_addr = dst_buf + anchor[0](x) + 7 + (anchor[1](y) + 6) * stride. Call fd2_render_combat_hp_bar_segments(bar_addr, stride, segments). The scale/divide is the signed IMUL/IDIV sequence; hp_current is a zero-extended word so the signed '<=0' guard reduces to '==0'.
signature: void __cdecl fd2_render_combatant_hp_bar_proportional(uint32 dst_buf, uint32 stride, uint32 char_idx, uint32 anchor_xy_ptr)

params.name: dst_buf
params.semantics: Base address of the render target. Callers pass 0xA0000 (mode13h framebuffer base) or large_game_state_buffer + 0x7964 (offscreen workspace).
params.reason: Accurately names the destination buffer base; no address residue.

params.name: stride
params.semantics: Row pitch in bytes of the destination buffer (0x140=320 for framebuffer, 0x1C8=456 for workspace). Used to compute the bar row offset and forwarded to the segment renderer.
params.reason: Standard, accurate name for the row stride; no address residue.

params.name: char_idx
params.semantics: Index into data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr selecting the combatant whose HP bar is drawn.
params.reason: Accurately describes the runtime-char array index; no address residue.

params.name: anchor_xy_ptr
params.semantics: Pointer to a 2-int {x, y} panel-anchor pair. The function reads anchor[0] (x, left inset) and anchor[1] (y, row base). Callers pass &xy[0] / &xy[2] from the panel xy array, or the speech-bubble descriptor / descriptor+8 in the AI attack path.
params.reason: Descriptive and accurate (pointer to the {x,y} anchor); no address residue.

returns.semantics: No return value; renders directly into dst_buf (early-returns and renders nothing when the combatant is dead).
